newsitem.title: JAPAN: PRESS DIGEST - Top Japan business news - March 26.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Top Japan business news - March 26.

text.p: Following are some of the leading stories in the Japanese press on Wednesday, as reported by Kyodo news agency:
-- Investigators raid Nomura Securities Co Ltd on Tuesday over its suspected illegal payments to a corporate client.
-- Creditors agree to bail out debt-ridden Tobishima Corp.
-- Guarantor commission to present final compromise plan to hostage-takers in Lima.
-- Prime Minister Ryutaro Hashimoto plans to present bill to secure U.S. military land leases in Okinawa.
-- Economic Planning Agency report attributes budget problems facing local governments to state subsidies.
-- Hashimoto seeks help from Social Democratic Party (SDP) and New Party Sakigake on base leases dispute in Okinawa.
-- Tokyo prosecutors question former policeman in shooting of National Police Agency head Takaji Kunimatsu.
